svg.title: Pastry chef — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as pastry chef, wearing a chef jacket and a chef hat. Visible work cue: An angled piping bag points toward the rounded icing on a small fluted cupcake. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a chef hat.
